title: Where your paycheck goes before you see it

lines.text: Your paycheck says one number. Your bank account gets a smaller one. Here's where the rest goes.
Gross pay is what you earn. Net pay is what actually lands in your account.
First up, Social Security and Medicare. Together they take 7.65% of most paychecks.
lines.say: First up, Social Security and Medicare. Together they take seven point six five percent of most paychecks.

lines.text: On four thousand dollars a month, that's three hundred and six dollars.
Then federal income tax, state income tax in most states, and anything you signed up for, like health insurance or a 401k.
lines.say: Then federal income tax, state income tax in most states, and anything you signed up for, like health insurance or a four oh one k.

lines.text: Tip: read your pay stub once. It shows every dollar, and it's how you catch mistakes.
That's the money. See you at the next bell.
